title: OpenMHS snapshot
description: Result of mhs.snapshot (MHS-002 9.1). Only simulated/hybrid devices with fidelity.snapshot_restore=true and replay devices may produce one. Canonical wire field: `state` (the {resource_id: state} document). `snapshot` is the retained backward-compatible alias for the same document; a snapshot MUST carry at least one of the two, and endpoints SHOULD emit both with identical content. `snapshot_digest` is the canonical digest of the state document. Restoring a snapshot MUST reproduce `revision` and `state_hash`; `device_id`, `instance_id`, `mode` and `fidelity_digest` are mandatory identity/fidelity metadata, and a snapshot from another device/instance/fidelity configuration MUST be rejected (PROTO-035/FID-004).

instance_id.description: ULID of the device instance (the same identity that devices.get and restore compare against).

state.description: Canonical state document: {resource_id: resource state}, exactly as served by mhs.resource.read and bound by state_hash under the device's hash_exclusions.

snapshot.description: Backward-compatible alias of `state`; when both are present they MUST be identical.

fidelity_digest.description: Digest of the serving device's declared fidelity configuration; a snapshot from another fidelity instance MUST be rejected (FID-004).
